theorems.name: Submission.deformation_mass_restriction
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∃ (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (v : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ IsMeasureRepresentation X μ v ∧ μ X.supportᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ (μ' : Measure (Eucl N)) (v' : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsMeasureRepresentation X μ' v' → ∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → Bornology.IsBounded A → ∀ α : Covector (Eucl N) k, ∫ x in A, v' x α ∂μ' = ∫ x in A, v x α ∂μ) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, IsRestriction X A Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, Y ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Eucl N), IsOpen W → Y.massOn W = μ (W ∩ A)) ∧ (∀ Y' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, IsRestriction X A Y' → Y' = Y) ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
